To find the number of integers from 1 to 8,000 divisible by at least one of 6, 10, or 15:
- Divisible by 6: $\lfloor 8000/6 \rfloor = 1333$
- Divisible by 10: $\lfloor 8000/10 \rfloor = 800$
- Divisible by 15: $\lfloor 8000/15 \rfloor = 533$
- Divisible by $\text{lcm}(6,10) = 30$: $\lfloor 8000/30 \rfloor = 266$
- Divisible by $\text{lcm}(6,15) = 30$: $\lfloor 8000/30 \rfloor = 266$
- Divisible by $\text{lcm}(10,15) = 30$: $\lfloor 8000/30 \rfloor = 266$
- Divisible by $\text{lcm}(6,10,15) = 30$: $\lfloor 8000/30 \rfloor = 266$

Total divisible by at least one of 6, 10, or 15:
$1333 + 800 + 533 - 3(266) + 266 = 2666 - 532 = 2134$

Next, find how many of these are divisible by 13:
- Divisible by $\text{lcm}(6,13) = 78$: $\lfloor 8000/78 \rfloor = 102$
- Divisible by $\text{lcm}(10,13) = 130$: $\lfloor 8000/130 \rfloor = 61$
- Divisible by $\text{lcm}(15,13) = 195$: $\lfloor 8000/195 \rfloor = 41$
- Divisible by $\text{lcm}(30,13) = 390$: $\lfloor 8000/390 \rfloor = 20$

Total divisible by 13 as well:
$102 + 61 + 41 - 3(20) + 20 = 204 - 40 = 164$

Subtracting those divisible by 13:
$2134 - 164 = 1970$

FINAL: 1970
